title: Chapter 1286
text:
"Yo, the main storyline mission is out."

"Calamity of the Supers? What's that? "

"It's probably referring to the conflict between the three Universal Civilizations and the association. I feel like this name is a bit crooked. How did Supers become a calamity?"

The crowd whispered among themselves.

Calamity of the Supers was supposed to be the name of Version 5.0, but now, it was changed to Black, so everyone was unfamiliar with this term.

This mission was not issued by Han Xiao himself but was automatically generated by the interface. It was similar to the main storyline mission of Version 5.0 in his previous life, but there were some slight changes, such as the addition of Han Xiao's figure.

Everyone opened the interface to check the mission, and the mission introduction jumped into their eyes.

This is a crisis that affects the entire Super class. There is a deep-rooted conflict between individual strength and collective civilization. Black Star chose the path of seeking peace through deterrence, igniting the fuse and detonating this storm called the Supers Crisis, single-handedly starting a new era. As a Super, you should have your own stance and ideals in this storm, choose your own faction, and fight for it.

As a member of the Black Star Corps, you might be willing to stand on the army's front line in this crisis and complete the army's great goal.

Everyone looked down. This main storyline mission was related to faction conflict. As a Grade S main storyline mission, the duration was very long, and they could continue to receive rewards. They were required to choose a faction in this storm and fight for it, and their faction was preset to be the Black Star Corps. During this mission period, every time they completed a mission assigned by their faction, they would receive additional faction Contribution Points and experience, which was very generous.

"The rewards are really not bad, and the mission rewards are clearly higher than in the previous version. The foundation has improved again."

"This incident affects the entire Super class. It feels like the impact is even greater than the development of the Flickering World in the previous version. Although the previous version also mobilized the entire universe, it was mainly for exploration, and most of the events were limited to one Star Field. This Calamity of the Supers is obviously very confrontational. Which part of the universe doesn't have Supers? The entire galactic society is going to be shaken. "

"Actually, I think this is pretty good. The main storyline was pointed out as soon as the version was released, and the goal was clear."

Everyone chatted in twos and threes.

Although it was a little sudden to be involved in such a big incident as soon as they came online, the army players quickly accepted this reality and felt excited.

After marveling at Black Star's deeds for a while, everyone quickly turned their attention to other aspects of the version update.

"Right, it's been 50 years. The army should have updated many of its internal products. Let's take a look."

Not long after, someone opened the army's faction store to check the equipment and weapons provided to the internal members.

The equipment sold by the army had always been the focus of the players. Although it was a little expensive, the quality was guaranteed. The performance was excellent, and the after-sales repair, enhancement, and other services were quite complete. A large number of players were using the army's standard equipment. Every time the army's logistics department updated their equipment series, it was the time for the army players to collectively improve their overall combat strength. At the same time, it could also reduce the fat on their wallets.

With just one look, the many army players were stunned for a moment before they were overjoyed.

In the interface of the faction store, the number of the army's internal products had multiplied many times compared to a few decades ago. There was a large pile of equipment, equipment, raw materials, and special items that had never been seen before. Furthermore, they were all high-quality products after the update.

Many of them were new technologies in Jayz's Treasure. Han Xiao picked out some suitable ones and threw them to the logistics department to create many new things, greatly expanding the scale of the faction's specialty products.

"Wow, the army's research in recent years has been very impressive. There are so many new products."

"I'm still wearing the seventh-generation equipment set. Now, it's been updated to the twelfth generation. The performance has been improved so much!"

"It's over, it's over. The previous equipment sets are all outdated. Changing to a new set costs a sum of money, enhancing, polishing, and enchantment costs another sum of money, and matching new weapons costs another sum of money. I feel like my wallet is going to die."

The eyes of the players instantly turned red. Looking at so many good things, their desire to buy them was unprecedentedly strong.

It was a pity that the national war and the Pro League at the end of Version 4.0 had emptied the savings of most people. Most people could only be envious, and their desire turned into the desire to earn money.

At this moment, everyone's internal program received an email from the Army Commander.

Opening the email, it was Han Xiao representing the army to welcome the return of the Immortals. He also stated that the current situation was sensitive, and he hoped that everyone would restrain themselves. At the end of the email, there was a note saying that the former stage of the national war, Planet Milton, had been purchased by the army and given to the Yan Huang Alliance as a gift.

No one had thought that there would be such a benefit. They were immediately stunned by this unexpected surprise and were dumbfounded.

"This … the Army Commander directly bought a national war planet and gave it to us? It's not an illusion, right? "

"Maybe this is the power of money …"

"Why would Old Black do this? He probably doesn't know about the national war, right?"

"That's hard to say. At that time, many galactic forces were paying attention to us. Although they didn't know about our national war, they could definitely see that the Immortals of different forces were competing. Our Yan Huang Alliance crushed everyone else. Maybe Old Black felt that we had won glory for the army?"

"I think it's possible!"

Everyone's faces were filled with excitement.

As the stage of the national war, Planet Milton had the potential to become a Main City. If the army directly bought it and gave it to the Yan Huang Alliance, it was equivalent to handing over the sovereignty of this Main City to the Chinese players. Originally, the management rights of this kind of planet basically belonged to the legitimate NPC forces. Who would have thought that it would fall into the hands of the players? This gift was not light.

This was the first player guild to own a planet!

At that time, many players participated in the national war, but they did not expect to receive such an additional reward from the faction. They could not help but be overjoyed.

Speaking of which, most of the Chinese players were the 'Blue Star Fellows' who first followed Old Black to explore the galaxy. This gift might be Old Black taking care of his fellows.

Thinking of this possibility, veteran players like Mad Blade were a little touched. This proved that Black Star had always had them in his heart!

Not long after, this matter spread to the forums, and countless players from the other factions were instantly jealous.

"It's the Black Star Corps' benefits again! How can their faction be so good?! "

"Damn it, I'm so jealous!"

"Black Star is indeed the model of starting from scratch. He really knows how to win people over. I also want to meet a faction leader like this."

"Wuwuwu, lemons are so good."

Seeing this scene, many foreign club players who had participated in the national war suddenly had a stifled expression, and their stomachs began to churn.

Originally, quite some time had passed since the national war, and these participants had already adjusted their mentality. Although they had lost, there were not many substantial losses. However, at this moment, these players felt that their hearts had been stabbed again.

Seeing the Yan Huang Alliance happily receiving a planet as a gift, these foreign clubs only felt annoyed.

If we had worked harder at the last moment and won the national war, this planet would have been ours today …

Oh, I forgot, we are not Black Star Corps members. Even if we won, the faction behind us would not have bought Planet Milton as a gift …

Thinking of this made them even more depressed!

As soon as tens of millions of players returned, the forums that had been silent for a long time instantly became lively.

The version had just been updated, and everyone was busy leveling up and updating their equipment. The most important thing was to fill their wallets. After understanding the current situation, many army players could not wait to take action.

…

At the same time, in the Army Commander's office, Han Xiao turned off the monitor in the hall and glanced at the experience bar on the interface. It began to rise rapidly, and he felt very comfortable.

Ah, this is the aroma of leeks ~

Comfortable.

"The players' savings have been mostly spent in the previous version, and the new version has just opened. They also have the need to level up, so I can only use new products and a certain discount to stimulate consumption and try to maintain the efficiency of harvesting experience."

Han Xiao stroked his chin with his fingers, his eyes shining.

The cost of leveling up now was extremely exaggerated. He had also accumulated some experience during the version update. According to the normal harvesting efficiency during the opening of the version, Han Xiao estimated that it would take one and a half to three years to fill up the experience pool for the level 360 Promotion. It was not a long time, but it was not short either. It mainly depended on the speed at which the players accumulated experience.

If he used his proficient leek management skills, he might be able to speed up the efficiency of the players.

Before the Promotion, Han Xiao also planned to max out his God's Trait Transformation in the Void Branch. This would also take some time to create more Universal Treasures.

The main storyline mission this time was a faction war. The association had a natural attraction to the players, and he was currently the leader of the association. Han Xiao was not worried about being poached. Instead, players would transfer to the army one after another.

"The players have returned. The fuse for the Calamity of the Supers is basically ready. It's just a matter of how the three Universal Civilizations react."

Han Xiao pondered.

…

On the mother planet of the Radiant Federation, in the President's Palace …

"The Immortals from all over the world have returned? Tsk, this is also a group of troublesome fellows. "

Louis, who was standing by the window, looked back at the head of the intelligence department and frowned. He secretly felt that this was troublesome.

"Do we need to take action?" the head of intelligence asked.

Louis returned to his seat, stroked his chin, and said thoughtfully.

"The Immortals … Could the principle of their resurrection be related to the Sanctum Revival?"

In the past year, the three Universal Civilizations had invested an astronomical amount of money into the Sanctum Revival research. There had indeed been some progress, but it was still far from producing results. In the field of Information Form, although the three Universal Civilizations were at the forefront of the explored universe, their technology was still not perfect.

The leaders of the three Universal Civilizations would ask about the research progress every few days, so Louis subconsciously associated the players with the Sanctum Revival. In his opinion, both were strange resurrection methods, so there might be some connection.

After pondering for a while, Louis said with a deep voice, "Those revivors are stubborn. We still can't find out the details of their resurrection process … Increase the funds for the Immortals research project. This might be another breakthrough."

"Understood."

The head of intelligence noted it down.

Louis paused and asked, "How's the public opinion in the outside world recently?"

"The class division is going well. Through the difference in treatment, one-sided publicity, and other means, we have successfully created a group of Supers who think that the association's ambition has affected the order. They are basically people who have been affected and lost benefits, so the Supers are divided into two voices. The number of objectors is not many at the moment, but it is enough. Their existence will make the Supers who support the association place more hope in it, constantly pushing the association to a higher altar, and even shouting the slogan of breaking off with the three Universal Civilizations. "

"Humph, well done." Louis narrowed his eyes. "Too much is bound to fall. The association has too many expectations placed on it. Once we can make the association suffer a small setback, we can achieve twice the result with half the effort, heavily damaging the association's prestige in the Supers and shaking more people's hearts."

The three Universal Civilizations did not wish for a leading force to appear in the Supers. Not only was the Supercluster Alliance fanning the flames, the three Universal Civilizations had also adjusted their strategy, secretly spreading the public opinion and dividing the voices of the Supers. They wanted to carry out a strategy of killing the association by attacking its high prestige in the Supers, making the Supers disappointed in it and destroying their confidence.

However, the time was not right yet, and there was no reason to test it now. There was no need to say that this move was not suitable for now.

Louis waved his hand to let the head of intelligence leave. After waiting for a while, two remote projections suddenly appeared in the room. They were 'Mechanical Queen' Mornisa and 'Guardian' Romo, both direct Beyond Grade A Mechanics of the Radiant Federation.

"You're here." Louis nodded, narrowed his eyes, and asked, "You asked to see me. Did you find the location of the Mecha Empire's main body?"

The direct Mechanics of the Radiant Federation had been searching for the location of Manison's main body all these years, but to no avail.

Romo shook his head. "He hid too well. We still have no news."

"Then why do you want to see me?" Louis frowned.

Mornisa took a step forward and slowly said, "I once studied with the Mecha Empire, so I'm very familiar with their Virtual Technology style. Not long ago, my technology made a breakthrough, so I've requested the three Universal Civilizations' help to hack into Manison's database!"

Louis was stunned. "What's the purpose of this?"

Mornisa's eyes sparkled. "I've taken a fancy to the Mecha Empire's technology vault. I want to get his life's work!"

She used to be a student of the Mecha Empire, so she knew better than anyone else just how rich Manison's foundation was. She had been eyeing Manison's technology vault for a long time, and the reason why their relationship turned cold was because Mornisa had once tried to steal some of his technology. After that incident, in order to protect herself, she became a direct member of the Radiant Federation.

Ever since Manison lost power, Mornisa had once again set her eyes on his technology. She was not confident in the past, but not long ago, Mornisa made a breakthrough, so her confidence returned.

Through her calculations, she believed that with her current Virtual Technology skills, as long as she could get the help of the three Universal Civilizations, there was more than a fifty percent chance that she could hack into Manison's database. The Mecha Empire was strong, but it could not stop others from targeting him.

"If this is the only reason, then I won't agree to your request." Louis shook his head and said, "Plus, the Mecha Empire is very famous. Are you sure you can crack their Virtual Technology?"

"Heh, I remember that the Mecha Empire has always liked to secretly infiltrate the Radiant Federation's database. After so many years, who knows how many secrets he has stolen. We've let him do as he pleases for too long. Don't you think it's time for the Radiant Federation to retaliate? No one will be able to find fault with it, and we'll destroy all the Radiant Federation secrets he has collected over the years! At the same time, we can get the secrets of the many Supercluster civilizations in the Primeval Star River from him. These are the real enemies of the three Universal Civilizations. "

Louis' eyes flashed, and he was a little tempted.

Currently, the three Universal Civilizations did not want to provoke the association, but if it was just hacking into the Mecha Empire's database, it would not be a big deal. While the three Universal Civilizations were wary of the association, they had never stopped their little tricks. Plus, the Mecha Empire was no longer the president, and they had always been on bad terms with Black Star.

This time, Mornisa sneered and continued.

"As for my ability … hehe, the Mecha Empire's strength has been weakening since Black Star took away more than half of the faith of the Machinery Faith. They are no longer at their peak.

As long as the three Universal Civilizations help me, I'm confident that I can hack into their database. After this is done, the Radiant Federation will be able to copy the technology. "

Louis' eyes flashed. After weighing the pros and cons, he slowly nodded.

"I agree to your request. I'll help you contact the Dynasty and Ethereal Federation. This plan can be tried, and we can test the association's reaction. Try to succeed. Don't disappoint me."

Hearing this, Mornisa smiled triumphantly.

"Don't worry, I'll make you so satisfied that you won't even be able to speak."
